messages.content: The document contains a story titled 'امید کی روشنی' (Light of Hope) about a hardworking boy named Ali from a small village. It describes how Ali, despite lacking books and having to work in the fields with his farmer father, received books as a gift from a man at school, which helped him become the best student. It also mentions an incident where Ali returned a lost wallet to its owner, refusing a reward, which impressed the villagers with his honesty and hard work.
